name: reveal
title: Reveal
description: Any block that arrives as it scrolls into view: a section heading, a card, a figure, a quote. It fades in and, depending on `effect`, rises a little, comes into focus or grows to size, once. Use it on the few things a reader should notice arriving, not on…
author: ofri-peretz <https://github.com/ofri-peretz>
docs:
## @interlace/reveal

Installed to `components/ui/effects/reveal.tsx`.

```tsx
import { /* … */ } from '@/components/ui/effects/reveal';
```

Props, a11y contract, live preview and source: https://ds.interlace.tools/c/reveal

Requires the `@interlace/interlace-base` CSS baseline (installed automatically as a registry dependency). For the Interlace look, also add `@interlace/theme`.
